description: Rep. Tim Wadsworth seeks re-election to continue representing Alabama’s HD 14, which includes rural portions of Cullman, Jefferson, Walker, and Winston counties. Wadsworth's campaign is focused on continuing the conservative leadership and community investment that have defined his time in office.
